messages:
sec-alert-bot: ALERT: high-risk SSO event for jdoe@redwood.com — impossible-travel heuristic triggered (US-CA -> DE within 22m). Multiple MFA push failures detected. Automatic session revoke executed.
amanda: saw the alert, assigning. tagging @sre-oncall and @maria for identity logs.
raj: ack. did revoke target the app sessions or console only?
amanda: revoke API called for all active tokens (user/refresh + web sessions). console shows 3 active sessions revoked.
maria: we see ~430 MFA pushes in 8m for the tenant associated with jdoe. Pushes mostly listed as 'delivered' then 'user dismissed' in a burst pattern. This looks like MFA fatigue/automation.
sre-oncall: any IPs or UA weirdness?
leo: quick grep of auth logs: 45 unique IPs across EU/NA with overlapping timestamps. Majority geo-hops from mobile carriers then cloud proxies. UA strings normal mobile browsers.
amanda: can someone pull the audit log for service-account token usage around 1777999000-1778001200? Need to check if any SA spun sessions for the user.
raj: running query now: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=audited_resource AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"service-account-deployer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" AND timestamp>\"2026-04-05T14:00:00Z\"" --limit 50`
maria: no obvious SA impersonation hits. But there's a spike in SAML assertion validations from our IdP to ACS for the tenant at 14:02Z.
ops-team: we've opened a tenant-facing incident page (INC-4521) and paused scheduled pushes for the tenant.
amanda: containment checklist: 1) revoke sessions (done) 2) force password reset? we prefer step 3. 3) require MFA re-enroll for affected accounts 4) rotate any exposed API keys linked to that tenant.
leo: KMS note — if we rotate keys for tenant artifacts, confirm HSM policy won't break ongoing decrypt ops. Pinged infra-crypto.
raj: forensics: pulled raw SSO assertion IDs and confirmed three assertions with malformed Audience fields, likely replayed. Saving artifacts to /var/forensics/inc-4521/assertions/ (sha256: f2b3...).
amanda: good. please also export audit logs to the secure bucket and set retention to 90d for this tenant.
maria: IdP vendor confirms sudden spike correlates with a zero-day phishing campaign they saw yesterday targeting similar SaaS orgs. They recommend forced push re-auth and temporary stricter rate limits.
sre-oncall: implementing temporary rate limit on MFA pushes for that tenant (10/min) and global backoff for suspicious IPs via WAF.
ops-team: comms draft ready: short notice to the tenant about unusual sign-in activity and recommended password + MFA reset. Sending to CSM for approval.
amanda: action items (quick): - S1: forensic artifact upload + ticket INC-4521 (raj) - S2: force MFA re-enroll for 430 affected users (maria) - S3: temporary push-rate-limit + WAF IP block (sre-oncall) - S4: audit retention and KMS rotation check (leo) - S5: RBAC review for deployer SA and rotation of any keys it used (amanda)
leo: RBAC: limiting SA scopes now to least privilege for deploy jobs. Adding requirement: all future SA token exchanges must go through short-lived OIDC flow.
raj: forensic note: we saw one anomalous token exchange from a region not associated with that tenant's user pool, marked suspicious. Recorded in incident timeline.
amanda: communications: exec summary for postmortem: timeline, containment steps, root cause hypothesis (phishing -> MFA fatigue -> assertion replay), mitigation, and long-term fixes (rate limits, stricter assertion validation, RBAC SA scope tighten, longer audit retention).
maria: scheduling 1h post-incident review tomorrow 1500Z. Invite: eng-security, infra-crypto, identity, and customer success.
sre-oncall: I've left a snippet in runbooks: `scripts/revoke_sessions.sh --user jdoe@redwood.com --revoke-refresh --export-logs /tmp/jdoe-revokes.log` — add this to the incident playbook.
ops-team: CSM approved tenant message and will send once we have confirmation of MFA re-enroll trigger.
amanda: final: closing immediate alert loop. keeping the channel open for follow-ups. will convert action items into Jira tickets and link to INC-4521. thanks all :thumbsup:
sec-alert-bot: Note: automated alert cleared (reason: sessions revoked + rate limit applied).
